desc: The Colt Combat Elite Government is a duty-ready pistol. The Government has full stainless steel construction with a unique two-tone PVD finish which makes for a striking corrosion package. The Dual Spring Recoil System reduces felt recoil while extending the recoil spring life. Features a genuine Novak night front sight and Novak Low Mount Carry night sight. Safeties are Ambi-Extended Thumb Safety, Upswept Beavertail Grip Safety, and Series 80 Firing Pin Safety.
